SELECT SUM(StateTotal), AVG(StateInvoiceCount)
FROM (
  SELECT c.State AS State,
         SUM(i.Total) AS StateTotal,
         COUNT(*) AS StateInvoiceCount
  FROM Invoice AS i
  JOIN Customer AS c ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId
  WHERE i.InvoiceDate >= '2010-06-22 00:00:00'
    AND i.InvoiceDate <= '2012-06-26 00:00:00'
  GROUP BY c.State
)
